BondoMod v0.2.24

- Fixed a painted Standard Boost reset after a goal. The fix passed a live test.
- Improved recognition when local loadout information arrives late. This is a possible fix for Pendix and other affected users, pending their confirmation.
- Expanded voluntary eight-minute diagnostics with encrypted match packets and the corrections sent to Rocket League. Start recording before using Launch RL, reproduce the issue, then stop and send the diagnostic.
- Failed diagnostic uploads are retained for retry.
- Fixed Lite access to Flex Mechs.
